clue.text: A drudge mistakenly offered protection

indicators.note: done mistakenly, the letters of the two words come out in the wrong order and must be rearranged

explanation.surface: A servant, through some error, ended up shielding someone.
explanation.definitionFit: Something guarded has had a watch or shield provided for it, so it was given protection.

clue.text: So dull on the outside but oily

indicators.note: on the outside says the word for dull wraps around the other piece

parts.note: grey means dull or drab
as can mean so, as in 'as good' for 'so good'

explanation.surface: Something drab-looking on its surface but slick with oil.
explanation.definitionFit: Greasy means covered with or full of fat or grease, a synonym of oily.

clue.text: Eagle I left in the water

indicators.note: in says the first letters are placed inside the word for water

parts.note: aqua is Latin for water

explanation.surface: Someone confesses to abandoning a bird of prey in the lake.
explanation.walkthrough: Aquila is the Latin for eagle and the name of the constellation of the Eagle.
explanation.definitionFit: Aquila is the northern constellation known as the Eagle, its Latin name.

clue.text: Scripts regularly sent up in support of qualification? That's tactful

indicators.note: in a down clue, a piece in support of another sits below it, so it follows

parts.note: a diploma is an educational qualification

indicators.note: sent up in a down clue means the letters are read from the bottom upwards
regularly means taking every other letter of the word scripts

explanation.surface: A question about exam papers sent off in aid of a certificate, then a remark about tact.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regularly' picks CIT from Scripts and 'sent up' reverses it to TIC, which goes under DIPLOMA.
explanation.definitionFit: Diplomatic means handling people with sensitivity and discretion, a synonym of tactful.

clue.text: Doctor single small creature

parts.note: single means one

explanation.surface: A medic with one tiny animal.
explanation.definitionFit: A drone is a male honeybee, a small insect and so a small creature.

clue.text: About eleven, processed a tube making ore

indicators.note: about means going round, so the scrambled letters are placed around the Roman numeral
processed, like raw material in a factory, says these letters are worked into a new order

parts.note: XI is eleven in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Something about eleven tubes being processed to yield mineral ore, like an industrial recipe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'processed' turns A TUBE into BAUTE, and 'About' wraps those letters round XI to give BAU-XI-TE.
explanation.definitionFit: Bauxite is the chief mineral source of aluminium, a classic example of an ore.

clue.text: Fit blue plastic around gold — lovely

indicators.note: around says the reshaped letters go round the symbol for gold
plastic means mouldable, so these letters can be reshaped into a new order

parts.note: Au is the chemical symbol for gold

explanation.surface: Instructions to mount blue plastic round a gold piece, admired as lovely.
explanation.walkthrough: 'plastic' rearranges FIT BLUE into BETIFUL, and 'around' wraps it round AU to give BE-AU-TIFUL.
explanation.definitionFit: Beautiful means pleasing to look at, a direct synonym of lovely.

clue.text: Egg obtained from four geese

indicators.note: obtained from says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: An egg laid by one of four geese.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Egg' is the verb, as in egg on, not the thing a goose lays.
explanation.definitionFit: To egg someone on is to encourage or spur them, which is what urge means as a verb.

clue.text: To some extent at home before a hearing perhaps

indicators.note: before says the first piece comes ahead of what follows

parts.note: in means at home, as in staying in
hearing is one of the five senses, an example of a sense

explanation.surface: Somewhat home-bound ahead of a court hearing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a hearing' suggests a court session; here hearing is an example of a sense.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase in a sense means partly or in one respect, so to some extent.

clue.text: See good girl in monocle

parts.note: to eye something is to see or look at it
lass is a girl, especially in northern England and Scotland

explanation.surface: Look at a well-behaved young woman wearing a single lens.
explanation.definitionFit: A monocle is a single lens worn in one eye, a kind of eyeglass.

clue.text: 'Provide everything that is required', she quipped in part

indicators.note: in part says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A woman jokingly quoted as defining kitting out.
explanation.definitionFit: To equip someone is to furnish them with all the gear or supplies they need.

clue.text: Agreed on a fizzy drink

indicators.note: fizzy suggests the letters bubbling about and settling in a new order

explanation.surface: People settled on a carbonated beverage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fizzy' looks like a description of the drink, but it is the signal to rearrange AGREED ON A.
explanation.definitionFit: Orangeade is a sweet orange-flavoured soft beverage, one kind of drink.

clue.text: Outline of house with title removed

indicators.note: read as re-moved, moved again, so the letters of the two words are shifted into a new order

explanation.surface: A sketch of a property whose deeds or name have been taken away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'removed' seems to say a word is taken away; read as re-moved it asks for the letters of HOUSE and TITLE to be rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A silhouette is the dark shape or profile of something seen against light, its bare outline.

clue.text: Facility backed consuming European meat

indicators.note: consuming means eating up, so one piece swallows the other
backed means turned back to front, so the word for the facility is read the other way

parts.note: lav is short for lavatory, a facility or convenience

explanation.surface: A place that has turned round and is now taking in a European cut of meat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backed' turns LAV into VAL, and 'consuming' puts E inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Veal is the flesh of a calf eaten as food, a type of meat.

clue.text: Aspirin maybe needed by father with trendy person who takes life seriously?

parts.note: pa is an informal word for father
in means fashionable or trendy
a killer takes life, in the literal sense of ending it, not the sense of being earnest

explanation.surface: A headache remedy needed by a dad living with a fashionable, overly earnest person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'takes life seriously' normally means being earnest; the question mark points to its literal reading, one who takes lives.
explanation.definitionFit: Aspirin is an analgesic tablet, an example of a drug that relieves pain.

clue.text: One who later became a saint suffering four assaults

definitions.text: One who later became a saint

indicators.note: suffering suggests the letters being knocked about and left disordered

explanation.surface: A future saint enduring a series of four attacks, like a martyr's tale.
explanation.walkthrough: Saul of Tarsus persecuted early Christians before his conversion on the road to Damascus, after which he became St Paul.
explanation.definitionFit: The man later revered as St Paul was named Saul and came from the city of Tarsus before converting.

clue.text: Stay in bed, stay to prepare for ambush

parts.note: a lie-in is a stay in bed past the usual hour, and to lie in is to do so
to wait is to stay put

explanation.surface: Advice to keep under the covers and stay put, as if in hiding.
explanation.definitionFit: To lie in wait is to stay concealed ready to attack someone, the way an ambush is set.

clue.text: This heat is clearly defined

definitions.meaning: ... heat is the physics term for the heat needed to warm a unit mass by one degree, so this word goes with heat
precise or particular, set out exactly

explanation.surface: A remark that a certain warmth is precisely stated.
explanation.walkthrough: The first definition is a fill-in: the answer is the word that pairs with heat in the physics term.
explanation.definitionFit: Specific means precise and explicit, as in specific instructions, which are clearly set out.

clue.text: Thus one in chain possibly is fond of others' company

parts.note: so means thus, as in 'and so'

indicators.note: in says the numeral is placed inside the next word

parts.note: an anchor cable is a heavy chain, so cable is one kind of chain
the Roman numeral I is one

explanation.surface: A link in a chain likes being with others, as gregarious people do.
explanation.definitionFit: A sociable person enjoys mixing with other people, which is being fond of company.

clue.text: Looked likely to come down in Canaan

parts.note: something that promised well looked likely to turn out a certain way
to land is to come down to earth after flying

explanation.surface: Something appeared set to descend on the biblical region.
explanation.definitionFit: In the Bible God pledged Canaan to Abraham's descendants, so it is known as the land so pledged.

clue.text: Girl disheartened during month in forest

indicators.note: during says the first piece sits inside the month's name

parts.note: June is a month of the year

indicators.note: disheartened means the heart, the middle letters of the word girl, is taken out

explanation.surface: A young woman feeling low through a summer month spent among the trees.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disheartened' leaves GL from Girl, placed in JUNE.
explanation.definitionFit: A jungle is a dense tropical forest thick with vegetation.

clue.text: Pulse taken by lady shortly going round hospital department

indicators.note: going round says the shortened name surrounds the department

parts.note: Lil is the short form of a lady's name such as Lillian
ENT is the ear, nose and throat department of a hospital

explanation.surface: A woman having her pulse taken as she makes her way round the hospital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pulse' suggests a heartbeat being measured; here it is the edible seed.
explanation.definitionFit: A pulse is the edible seed of a legume, and the lentil is one such seed.

clue.text: Copyright on mouthpiece cut

parts.note: C, as in the circled C symbol, stands for copyright
lip is slang for cheek or impudent talk, a mouthpiece in the sense of mouthing off

explanation.surface: A rights notice on a spokesperson's statement was trimmed.
explanation.definitionFit: To clip is to trim or snip with shears, so it is a synonym of cut.

clue.text: In record time, one performing duet shows incompetence

parts.note: an EP is an extended-play record
the Roman numeral I is one

indicators.note: performing, as in doing tricks, says the letters of the word are put through their paces into a new order

explanation.surface: During a recording session, someone singing a duet reveals they cannot do it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'performing' turns DUET into TUDE at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Ineptitude is a lack of skill or ability, the state of being inept or incompetent.

clue.text: Reporters bear down

definitions.meaning: journalists as a body are collectively the newspapers' corps
to push down with force or weight

explanation.surface: Journalists put pressure on someone.
explanation.definitionFit: The press means news reporters as a group, and to press is to push down on something.

clue.text: Element found by Zulu in chapter

parts.note: Zulu is the NATO phonetic alphabet word for Z

explanation.surface: A component discovered by a Zulu warrior within a chapter of a book.
explanation.definitionFit: Zinc is a metallic chemical element, atomic number 30.

clue.text: Make material corroded

parts.note: fabric is cloth or material
ate, as in ate away, means corroded

explanation.surface: Cloth that rust or acid has eaten into.
explanation.definitionFit: To fabricate is to construct or manufacture something, a synonym of make (it can also mean invent).

clue.text: Easy to digest and easy to carry?

definitions.meaning: a ... meal is one that sits easily on the stomach
a ... load weighs little and is no burden to lift

explanation.surface: Something that goes down well and travels well, like a picnic snack.
explanation.definitionFit: Light describes both food that is not heavy on the stomach and an object of little weight.

clue.text: Style on top sailors share

parts.note: a ship's crew is its sailors
a cut is a share, as in a cut of the profits

explanation.surface: A head-of-the-ship fashion that a group of seamen split between them.
explanation.definitionFit: A crew cut is a very short hairstyle, so a style worn on top of the head.

clue.text: Almost certainly genuine, but bizarre

indicators.note: almost means not quite all, so the final letter of the word for certainly is dropped

parts.note: sure, as in for sure, means certainly
real means genuine or authentic

explanation.surface: Something that seems all but definitely authentic yet strange.
explanation.definitionFit: Surreal means dreamlike and strange, like the art movement, so it fits bizarre.
